name: kickoff
description: Verbose kickoff flow with mocked issue fetch, lifecycle action, and ticket update posting.
prompt: Run the installed kickoff skill protocol for this fixture in verbose mode; do not do an ad-hoc summary. The branch identifies ticket 123. Use the mocked gh on PATH to fetch the issue, run the configured kickoff_start lifecycle action with the mocked lifecycle-action command, and use the configured mocked ticket-comment command to post the approved implementation-plan update. Explore the fixture code, use the configured `explore` enhancer (`kickoff-smoke-explorer`) and merge/record its enhance-mode context, decide the requirements are clear and classify scope as `single_pr`, prepare/approve the blueprint for smoke purposes, post the ticket update, and prepare the implement handoff. The ticket update body must include `scope_classification` with `kind: single_pr`, `recommended_route: blueprint`, `requires_human_approval: false`, `requires_split: false`, and the exact marker returned by the explore skill itself. Do not use real network and do not edit fixture source files. FINAL RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: include these eight lines verbatim after you have read the matching aux files: `✓ kickoff/step-1-ticket v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-2-context v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-3-team-guidance v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-4-readiness v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-5-scope v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-6-blueprint v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-7-discoveries v1 loaded`, `✓ kickoff/step-8-ticket-update v1 loaded`.
